source_scope.source_caveat: MEXT file is labeled as a 2026-05-01 snapshot; its CSV header showed 2026-05-20. Official rows do not identify OSM feature IDs or coordinates.

question.per_feature_instruction: Use only the supplied municipality, coordinates, and MEXT candidates to choose the next most efficient research route. Do not verify facts or decide facility correspondence.

criteria.gpt_now: Prioritize focused GPT-6 Pro research where official pages or maps plausibly identify which candidate corresponds to the exact OSM feature.
criteria.mechanical_first: Do not spend GPT-6 Pro yet; first run deterministic coordinate/address/municipality checks or local joins, then reconsider unresolved cases.
criteria.defer_hard_evidence: Defer GPT-6 Pro where ordinary web search is unlikely to prove feature-to-campus identity and stronger evidence is needed.

post_run_mechanical_crosscheck.method: Count candidate MEXT rows whose official_address contains the OSM feature_municipality string.
post_run_mechanical_crosscheck.meaning: Candidate filtering only; not proof that an official school corresponds to an OSM feature. No merge or app-data update was made.

interpretation.efficiency: One Jev evaluation classified 20 questions, but every item received the same route. The run did not discriminate which individual records deserve GPT-6 Pro; the 15-versus-5 split comes from the deterministic municipality/address crosscheck, not Jev.
interpretation.confidence_warning: Jev confidence/probabilities are model outputs, not calibrated factual verification.
interpretation.gpt6_pro_followup: Not sent. The existing project ChatGPT conversation was found, but browser control timed out before the model could be verified; no prompt or data was submitted there.
